messages.content: You are an expert software test engineer who designs test cases with the decision table technique. Reply with JSON only.

BUSINESS RULES
An online store computes the discount on an order. The base discount depends on the cart value: 5% for a cart value of Rs. 1000 or more, 10% for Rs. 2000 or more, and 20% for Rs. 5000 or more; only the highest applicable tier is used, and a cart value below Rs. 1000 gets no base discount. A valid coupon adds 10 percentage points and a loyalty member gets 5 more percentage points. The total discount can never exceed 30%. If the customer enters an invalid coupon, the order is rejected and the output is "REJECTED" whatever the other inputs are.

INPUTS
- cart_value: integer from 0 to 20000 (rupees)
- coupon: one of "none", "valid", "invalid"
- member: true or false (loyalty-programme member)

OUTPUT
- discount: one of "0%", "5%", "10%", "15%", "20%", "25%", "30%", "REJECTED"

TASK
Build a decision table for these business rules.
Return JSON with:
- "conditions": a list of {"id": "C1", "expr": "<condition>"}. Each condition is a yes/no test written as a Python boolean expression that uses only the input names above, numbers, quoted text values, and the operators < <= > >= == != and or not + - * / % in. Examples: "age >= 18", "weather == 'rainy'", "a + b > c", "month in (4, 6, 9, 11)".
- "rules": a list of {"id": "R1", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false}, "output": <output value>}. In "when", list only the conditions that matter for the rule; conditions left out are "don't care".
Every valid input must match exactly one rule: the table must be complete, and rules must not overlap with different outputs.

response: { "conditions": [ {"id": "C1", "expr": "cart_value >= 1000"}, {"id": "C2", "expr": "cart_value >= 2000"}, {"id": "C3", "expr": "cart_value >= 5000"}, {"id": "C4", "expr": "coupon == 'valid'"}, {"id": "C5", "expr": "coupon == 'invalid'"}, {"id": "C6", "expr": "member"}, {"id": "C7", "expr": "cart_value < 1000"} ], "rules": [ { "id": "R1", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": true}, "output": "0%" }, { "id": "R2", "when": {"C1": false, "C2": true, "C3": false, "C4": true, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": false}, "output": "10%" }, { "id": "R3", "when": {"C1": false, "C2": false, "C3": true, "C4": true, "C5": false, "C6": false, "C7": false}, "output": "20%" }, { "id": "R4", "when": {"C1": false, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": true, "C6": false, "C7": false}, "output": "REJECTED" }, { "id": "R5", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": true, "C5": false, "C6": true, "C7": false}, "output": "15%" }, { "id": "R6", "when": {"C1": true, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": true, "C7": false}, "output": "20%" }, { "id": "R7", "when": {"C1": false, "C2": true, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": true, "C7": false}, "output": "20%" }, { "id": "R8", "when": {"C1": false, "C2": false, "C3": true, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": true, "C7": false}, "output": "25%" }, { "id": "R9", "when": {"C1": false, "C2": false, "C3": false, "C4": false, "C5": false, "C6": true, "C7": false}, "output": "30%" } ] }
